title: Save the date
text: The 2027 LIDS Student Conference will take place February 6–7 at MIT.

title: Announcing Our first Plenary Speaker: Babak Hassibi
text: Professor Babak Hassibi will join the 2027 LIDS Annual Summit as a plenary speaker. We look forward to welcoming him.

text: Professor John Langford will join the 2027 LIDS Annual Summit as a plenary speaker. We look forward to welcoming him.
